action_items: Optional UX: agreement wizard shows a 'Subject' step (step 1) even though kind=agreement has no subject choice — step label 'Subject' may be misleading; consider hiding/relabeling the first step for the agreement flow.

Optional: on JointReport detail page for a non-ready safety report, page still shows only 'Complete My Assessment' with no red safety banner; consider surfacing safety cues earlier (JointAssessment already does).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py line 882 uses AGREEMENT_AREAS keys only if doc.kind == 'agreement'; every other joint report (including safety multi-subject) uses the 6 QUESTIONS keys — good and unambiguous. Note tests must submit the QUESTIONS keys for safety reports, which is a small footgun for API consumers vs the subject_keys.

prepare_pro_request creates the safety report with creator_role='professional' and does not include the requesting parent as created_by — parents therefore correctly do not see the report in their /joint/reports list before accepting the invitation. Good.

/api/professionals returns ALL professional users to any authenticated caller — consider whether this is a privacy concern for larger deployments (currently professional email + name is fully public to any logged in parent).
AgreementIn / ProRequestIn use pydantic EmailStr — good input validation; server correctly lowercases emails for comparison.
